summary: No qualifying refinance opportunities. All 20 base records fail at least one gating rule on the admissible evidence (published/effective on or before 2026-08-31): six Dallas Industrial records were moved out of market by executed amendments effective 2026-08-20 (R1118, R3402, R7201, R7702, R7833, and R8900 — which additionally has an executed extension to 2028-09-30), and the duplicated entity FIR-REF-74682 (R2663/R5151) was likewise moved to Seattle by an entity-level executed amendment. R5451 is Seattle at base and R5181 is Office. Remaining Dallas Industrial records fail on: inferred maturity (R2813), unconfirmed maturity plus unresolved extension option (R4743), maturity outside the window (R1776), unknown loan status (R7436), released loan (R9426), property-manager-only ownership (R4927), stale ownership verification (R1203), former employee contact (R7919), registered-agent-only contact (R9169), and post-cutoff publication (R5442). Therefore the shortlist is empty and no prospect facts can be asserted.
limitations: outstanding_balance_usd is null in every base extract; loan_amount_usd is original principal only and cannot be used as a balance proxy. Missing is treated as unknown, not zero.

Recorded release U-R1118-2 (published/effective 2026-09-10) suggests R1118's loan may since have been released, but it post-dates the cutoff and was not applied; R1118 is excluded on market grounds instead.
R5442 (Fir Point 18) may otherwise have met the criteria on its face, but its only source is published 2026-09-03, after the cutoff, so it cannot be evidenced.
Unsigned draft U-R7702-3 (maturity 2028-01-01) was disregarded per the rules; if later executed it would further alter R7702's maturity.
Executed amendments changing 'market' were applied at face value as controlling scope evidence; no independent corroboration of the market reassignments is available in the packet.
No SPV-to-parent mappings were supplied in the extracts, so no parent-level sponsor consolidation was possible beyond the duplicate entity FIR-REF-74682.

Contact emails are the only published contact channel provided; no verification beyond the stated email_basis and contact_verified_at fields was possible, and none were used since no records qualified.
Artifact generation (prospect CSV / comp-grid XLSX) is outside this direct API control; no file was created or delivered. With an empty shortlist, such a file would contain no data rows in any case.
